skills.name: Entrapment
skills.description: Cyrille's incredible group hunting skills allow her to call many more to the hunters' fest, increasing Bear Hunt Rally Capacity by 30,000 → 300,000.

skills.name: Scavenging
skills.description: No hunting weapon is lost in Cyrille's capable hands. Her recycling efforts grant 1 → 5 x100 Enhancement XP Component rewards every Bear Hunt.

skills.name: Weapon Master
skills.description: Cyrille's knowledge extends to hero gear expertise, increasing Essence Stone rewards obtained in Bear Hunt by 1 → 5.

skills.name: Ursa's Bane
skills.description: Cyrille's command skills transfer well into the hunting realm, increasing Bear Hunt Troops Deployment capacity by 3,000 → 30,000.

talent.name: Earthbreaker
talent.description: Cyrille is a repository of bear-hunting skills and knowledge, increasing Bear Hunt Damage Points by up to 2% → 30% (effective for self only).

skills.name: Efficient Recon
skills.description: Not all spymaster plans are created equal, and Agnes is a master of enhanced Lighthouse scouting, giving 2 → 8 extra Intel missions per day.

skills.name: Optimization
skills.description: Improved can production efficiency boosts Storehouse Chief Stamina gain by 10 → 40.

skills.name: Project Management
skills.description: Good project management is a precursor to efficient construction. Agnes speeds up construction by 2 → 8 hours on every new build.

skills.name: Covert Knowledge
skills.description: The wisdom of the ancients has not been forgotten by Agnes, giving 20 → 120 additional Mystery Badge(s) upon daily mission completion and 1 → 4 more free refreshes at the Mystery Shop.

talent.name: Earthbreaker
talent.description: Arcadia's advanced drill machine can even identify useful items buried near gathered resources. Gives 1 → 5 Seeker Chest(s) every 120 gathering minutes (up to 10 → 30 chest(s) daily, refreshing at 0:00 UTC.)

skills.name: Arena Elite
skills.description: Tough training gets tough trainee results. Holger's rigorous program increases Arena heroes' Attack and Health by 2% → 20%.

skills.name: Crowd Pleaser
skills.description: Holger knows how to put on a show and so will his heroes. Holger's classic crowd-pleasers increase both daily and weekly Arena Tokens earned by 5% → 50%. Level Arena Token Gain Lvl.1 5% Lvl.2 10% Lvl.3 15% Lvl.4 20% Lvl.5 25% Lvl.6 30% Lvl.7 35% Lvl.8 40% Lvl.9 45% Lvl.10 50%

skills.description: Holger is a true Ace of the Arena and that means his Chief's and heroes get the star treatment: 0 → 3 more items in the Arena Shop at an 5% → 50% discount.

skills.name: Legacy
skills.description: Holger is in the Arena legend-creation process, giving heroes 2% → 20% additional Attack and Health in the Arena. Level Hero Stats Up Lvl.1 2% Lvl.2 4% Lvl.3 6% Lvl.4 8% Lvl.5 10% Lvl.6 12% Lvl.7 14% Lvl.8 16% Lvl.9 18% Lvl.10 20%

talent.name: Blade Dancing
talent.description: Holger knows the best rewards in the Arena are often won from the crowd. Holger's winsome techniques give 50% → 100% chance of audience reward: 1 → 3 Arena Star Chest(s).

skills.name: Call of War
skills.description: Romulus mobilizes to win, allowing free recruitment of 150 → 600 additional high-level troops from any Camp per day as well as an additional 1 → 10 Loyalty Tag(s) from the Enlistment Office.

skills.description: Solaris' tactics didn't save the empire, but Romulus can rework them to protect you. talent.description: Commander Romulus is an expert at large deployments, increasing heroes' Expedition Army size limit by 300 → 10,000.

skills.name: Blazing Sunrise
skills.description: An exquisite Badge to show off outstanding Alliance member contributions. +20% Alliance Mobilization Points, +3 milestone bonus tier(s)

skills.name: Honored Conquest
skills.description: Baldur has crafted more badges to showcase outstanding Alliance contributors. +50% Alliance Championship Badges in Alliance Championship and +3 Alliance Championship Shop bonus items.

skills.name: Bounty Hunter
skills.description: Baldur has added of his fortune to the sizeable bounty on Crazy Joe and her underlings, earning +50% Crazy Joe point rewards and a bonus Chest per 200,000 points (limit of 10 per season).

skills.name: Dawn Hymn
skills.description: Baldur is a master strategist particularly around points, gaining +50% Alliance Showdown points (except Tundra Trade Route) and +3 bonus tier(s) for the daily milestone reward.

talent.name: Master Negotiator
talent.description: Thanks to Baldur's reputation and charm, the prices for items at the Alliance Shop are reduced by +15% , and rewards from Personal Activity Triumph Chests are increased by +100% Defense.

skills.name: Salvager
skills.description: Metals from the filed of war can be salvaged into coinage. Arsenal Tokens +10% → 100%.

skills.name: Crisis Rescue
skills.description: Fabian is a medically-minded armorer. His first aid team allows instant recovery of 100,000 → 1,000,000 troops each Foundry Battle and Tundra Hellfire.

talent.name: Craftsman of War
talent.description: Fabian's mighty weapons grant all allied troops in Foundry Battle and Tundra Hellfire 2% → 30% Attack and 2% → 30% Defense.

skills.name: Well Prepared
skills.description: Valeria pays meticulous attention to every detail during battle preparation, gaining +20% State of Power's Preparation Phase Point gains, and +3 bonus tier for daily Personal Point rewards.

skills.name: Radiant Honor
skills.description: Valeria's rally ignites the troops' desire for glory, increasing Sunfire Tokens earned when claiming Medal Rewards by 50 and adding 3 extra items to the State of Power Shop.

skills.name: Battle Concerto
skills.description: Valeria demonstrates exceptional tactical mastery, all troops' Lethality and Health +30% during State of Power's Battle Phase.

skills.name: Crushing Force
skills.description: Valeria's remarkable leadership increases Rally Capacity in State of Power Battle Phase by 150,000 .

talent.name: Conqueror's Spirit
talent.description: Valeria showcases her talent for commanding large-scale expeditions, all troops' Attack and Defense +30% in State of Power Battle Phase.

skills.name: Cartographic Memory
skills.description: Ronne’s photographic route memory accelerates arrival times by +2% → +20%. Her storied reputation with clients allows 1 → 3 more free refreshes per truck.

skills.name: Treasure Scent
skills.description: Ronne’s nose for sniffing out hidden truck treasure is second to none, granting a 10% → 100% chance of raiding 1 extra cargo.

skills.name: Giving Back
skills.description: Ronne retaliates with even greater strength when raided, gaining a 5% → 50% chance of recovering 1 cargo (Ronne escorts 0 → 2 "Elite Guardbox" cannot be raided.)

skills.name: Gold Class
skills.description: An escort guard of Ronne's renown is always highly sought after, ensuring a "Legendary" escort mission after each 12 → 4 completed missions that remains even if refreshed. Legendary Trucks will have better rewards, especially for 3 of its cargo. (Ronne escorts 1 extra truck daily when this skill reaches Lv. 10).

talent.name: Trade Dominion
talent.description: Ronne is the undisputed ruler of the Tundra Trade Routes. When her caravan is raided or when she attacks other trucks in the tundra, her troops gain +2% → 30% Attack and Defense.

skills.name: Icefire Hunter
skills.description: Kathy's deft guidance in Frostfire Mine grants our troops 5% → 50% additional XP from defeating Mine Patrols for Frostfire Skill upgrades.

skills.name: Valorous Cold
skills.description: Kathy's leadership skills honed in the burning cold of Frostfire allow 5,000 → 50,000 extra troop capacity and shorten hero recovery after defeat by 6% → 60%.

skills.name: Winter Treasures
skills.description: The art of Orichalcum cutting transfers well to Charms. Kathy will obtain 6 → 60 additional Charm Designs on obtaining 200,000 Orichalcum in the Frostfire Mine event.

skills.name: Efficient Mining
skills.description: Kathy's efficient mining teams never waste a moment even between battles. Kathy earns 500 → 5,000 Orichalcum per minute once the Frostfire Mine battle phase begins. Kathy will obtain 10 → 100 additional Charm Guides on obtaining 200,000 Orichalcum in the Frostfire Mine event.

talent.name: Child of Frost
talent.description: Kathy's Frostfire Mine expertise gained over many years increases our troops' Lethality and Health by 2% → 30% in Frostfire Mine battles.

skills.name: Gifts of Iron
skills.description: Gareth enjoys great prestige among tribesmen. For every 100 troops trained, Gareth is granted with 1 → 3 Ironwrought Chest, up to 6 → 30 per day.

skills.name: Porcupine
skills.description: Jarnvid's mercenaries faces enemies with close formations and iron discipline, resulting in +1% → +50% Troops' Defense.

skills.name: Undefeated Will
skills.description: Gareth's encouragement and command unleash his soldiers' maximum potential, resulting in +1% → +50% Troops' Health.

skills.name: Fearsome Reputation
skills.description: Fear of the "Spiked Commander" is the end for weakened enemies, reducing Enemy Troop's Lethality by 0.25% → 5%.

talent.name: Rallying Cry
talent.description: As a commander, Gareth knows the importance of keeping his men alive. He dedicates significant effort to treating wounded soldiers, resulting in +50,000 → +200,000 Infirmary Capacity and +3% → +50% healing speed.
